_meanings:
.²1 The performance of a particular Śrāddha in honour of deceased relatives
 called {#sapiRqa#} <ab>q. v.</ab>, to be performed at the end of one full year
 after the death of a relative, but now usually performed on the 12th day
 after death as part of the funeral obsequies.
.²2 Giving a person the rights of a Sapiṇḍa or kinsman.
